title: Global Economy Leaderboard & Privacy
summary: The public economy leaderboard is now a paginated global ranking, ranked by net worth, with a dashboard privacy control that lets members protect their identity without leaving the rankings.

highlights.title: A Live, Paginated Rich List
highlights.description: Browse global economy standings a page at a time, with stable ranks and net-worth totals across the full leaderboard.

highlights.title: Choose Your Visibility
highlights.description: Members can make their leaderboard profile private from the dashboard. Private profiles remain ranked, while their identity is shown only to the account owner, official Niko staff, and people who share a guild with them.

highlights.title: Efficient Page Loading
highlights.description: Leaderboard pages are fetched with bounded database-side pagination, keeping requests focused on the requested slice of rankings.

items: Public global economy leaderboard with net-worth rankings and previous/next pagination
Dashboard economy privacy preference for hiding a member’s identity on the public leaderboard
Privacy-aware identity visibility for account owners, official Niko staff, and mutual-guild members
Leaderboard loading uses bounded database-side pagination and retains global rank numbers between pages
The Discord leaderboard command links directly to the public leaderboard page and explains its privacy behavior
